From the Measurement Lab

We are opening our measurement toolkit

For six years we have built our own instruments, because the ones we could buy measured what was easy rather than what mattered.

Today the toolkit is public. Anyone can run it, read it and change it, and we will answer every question asked in the open.

We are doing this because measurement that only one lab can check is not measurement. It is an opinion with a number on it.
